items.wrong: I playing when it started to rain.
items.fix: I was playing when it started to rain.

items.why: In questions, were goes before you.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: We was playing football. → We were playing football. | I playing when it started to rain. → I was playing when it started to rain. | What you were doing? → What were you doing?.
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

errors.w: I playing when it started to rain.
errors.r: I was playing when it started to rain.

facts.label: No parque
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação longa e when + passado simples para a curta: We were playing football when it started to rain.

facts.label: Passado contínuo
facts.sub: Para dizer o que estava acontecendo, use was ou were + verbo com -ing: I was playing. We were running. Use was com I, he, she e it, e were com you, we e they.

facts.label: Quando
facts.sub: Use when para a ação curta: We were playing football when it started to rain. A ação curta fica no passado simples. Assim você mostra que a chuva chegou no meio do jogo.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “estávamos jogando quando começou a chover”.
compare.tip: Diga: “We were playing when it started to rain.”
compare.us: Em inglês: was/were + -ing e when + passado simples.
